description: Moves an earlier attempt to Paletoo’s Trash, so the person keeps one good file instead of several tries: a design this assistant made for this person in this conversation (within the last 6 hours) with create_design, compose_design or another tool that makes a design. Any other design is left as it is, and so is `kept`. Trash restores it (Paletoo › Trash). Example: { design: «the earlier attempt’s id», kept: «the design that takes its place» }.

design.description: the earlier attempt: its id or link (made by this assistant in this conversation)

kept.description: the design that takes its place (optional): never moved to Trash

name: discard_attempt
title: Discard an attempt
